name: SelectivePdfSplitter
label: Smart PDF Page Splitter
description: Splits a PDF into pages based on selection mode: All, Odd, Even, Range, Specific Pages, or By Chunk Size.

fields.name: PdfFilePath
fields.label: PDF File Path
fields.description: Full path to the source PDF file to split (e.g., C:\docs\input.pdf).

fields.name: OutputDirectory
fields.label: Output Directory
fields.description: Directory where split page PDFs will be saved (e.g., C:\output).

fields.name: SelectionMode
fields.label: Selection Mode
fields.description: Choose how to select pages: All, Odd, Even, Range, Specific Pages, or By Specified Page Size.

selectOptions.label: All Pages
selectOptions.description: Splits every page in the PDF into individual files.

selectOptions.label: Custom Range
selectOptions.description: Creates one PDF per range spec (e.g., "1-3,5,7-9" => files for 1-3, 5-5, 7-9).

selectOptions.label: Specific Pages
selectOptions.description: Group specified pages into chunked PDFs (defaults to 10 pages per file, padded).

selectOptions.label: Split Pages Per File
selectOptions.description: Splits the PDF into groups of N pages per output file (e.g., 10 pages per PDF).

fields.name: PageRange
fields.label: Page Range
fields.description: For 'Custom Range' mode, specify pages like '1-3,5,7-9'. Ignored for other modes.

fields.name: SpecificPages
fields.label: Specific Pages
fields.description: For 'Specific Pages' mode, specify individual pages like '10,20,30'. Ignored for other modes.

fields.name: PagesPerFile
fields.label: Pages Per File
fields.description: For 'By Pages Per File' mode or 'Specific Pages' grouping, number of pages per output PDF (e.g., 10).

fields.name: PagePrefix
fields.label: Page Prefix
fields.description: Optional prefix for output filenames (e.g., 'page_' → page_1.pdf or page_chunk_001.pdf).

fields.name: SavedFolderPath
fields.label: Saved Folder Path
fields.description: The folder where all split PDF pages were saved.

fields.name: PageCount
fields.label: Page Count
fields.description: Total number of pages split (actual pages, excluding padded blanks).
